A floor re-derived without saying which units were real is the same defect in fresher paint, so: floor said 12954, the branch holds 12113 at d700c33e3d7. The 841-unit gap is NOT this change's work and is NOT attributable -- it accumulated between the cohort re-banking and now, and it cannot be split into 'the old reading was wrong' and 'later commits drove it down' because the old stamp b7b596cd004b is not an object in this repository, so the tree it was measured on cannot be inspected by anyone. Measured in a detached worktree via py_function_length.py --addon addons; odoo-77 and odoo-78 read 12113 independently at the same tip, and the shared dirty checkout also reads 12113, so no session's uncommitted work moves it. Why the drift went unseen: this is the only odoo-side --mode no-increase gate, so it fails upward only and a floor sitting 841 above the tree is inert rather than red -- 841 units of new long-function debt could have landed undetected. That is the reason for lowering it rather than re-stamping 12954: a floor above the tree is not conservative, it is switched off. Note preserved from pyfunclen_crm, because it explains why this number moves without new code: py_function_length budgets a function in LINES, so removing a comment line and re-wrapping the statement beneath it are equal and opposite, and a pure ruff format pass moves this floor on its own.
